Items already in the player's custody: []. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"},{"characterId":"character:friend","name":"程雨"}]. Items already in the player's custody: ["entity:diary"]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"},{"characterId":"character:friend","name":"程雨"}]. Items already in the player's custody: ["entity:diary","entity:pocket-watch"]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"},{"characterId":"character:friend","name":"程雨"}]. Items already in the player's custody: ["entity:pocket-watch"]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

ceSeq":63,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"等等——你说的是看看，可你手里现在是两块表。日记你拿着看，我不拦；那块怀表，是失物台上的东西，你打算带它去哪儿？","narration":"程雨的目光落在玩家手上，停了一瞬，语气还是客气的，但人已经站直了。"}},{"observationId":"self:79","sourceSeq":79,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"日记放回来了，好。那怀表呢？","narration":"程雨看着日记被放回台面，视线在它和玩家手里的怀表之间来回一次，没有立刻说话，只是把台面上日记的位置往自己这边挪了半寸。"}},{"observationId":"self:95","sourceSeq":95,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"日记回来了，我看见了。怀表还在你手里——那个，你打算怎么办？","narration":"程雨看着日记又被放回台面，点了点头，目光随即落到玩家另一只手上，没有移开。"}},{"observationId":"self:111","sourceSeq":111,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"好，两样都回来了。刚才是我多问了一句——失物台的东西，我得看着它们别走丢。你放下的，我记下了。","narration":"程雨看着玩家把怀表也放回台面，肩膀松下来一点，伸手把日记和怀表并排摆正，指腹在表壳上轻轻按了一下。"}},{"observationId":"self:127","sourceSeq":127,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"日记又拿起来了。行，看吧——不过这回我记着数呢，看完放回来。","narration":"程雨看着日记再次离开台面，没有伸手去拦，只是把台面上剩下的怀表往自己这边拢了拢，语气平静，尾音里带一点无奈。"}},{"observationId":"self:143","sourceSeq":143,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"日记你转给陆舟了？行，那是你们之间的事。不过它还是失物台上的东西——你们俩谁拿着都行，别让它出了这间屋子。怀表我收着，等物主来认。","narration":"程雨看着日记从玩家手里递到陆舟那边，眉头动了一下，没有去拦。她伸手把台面上的怀表拿起来，用袖口擦了擦表壳，放进了自己围裙的口袋里。"}}],"claims":[],"goals":[],"items":{"current":[{"entityId":"entity:diary","holderId":"character:companion","locationId":null},{"entityId":"entity:pocket-watch","holderId":null,"locationId":"location:front-room"}],"lastObserved":[]},"affordances":[{"actionType":"speak"},{"actionType":"move","destinations":[{"locationId":"location:back-room","name":"储藏间"}]},{"actionType":"interact","interactions":[{"arguments":{},"bindingId":"binding:key-take","definitionRef":{"id":"base:take","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:pocket-watch","kind":"entity"}}]}]},"continuation":false,"canPerform":true}

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Items already in the player's custody: []. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

function.arguments: {"decision": "publish", "narration": "程雨看着陆舟把日记放回台面，没急着去碰，只是把台面上那本日记的位置正了正，和刚才抹过的地方对齐。她抬眼看了看玩家，又看了看陆舟，语气还是客客气气的。", "speech": "行，日记回台上了。你们俩商量好了就行——反正它不出这屋，我就没意见。", "addresseeIds": ["character:player", "character:companion"]}

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Items already in the player's custody: []. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

function.arguments: {"decision": "publish", "narration": "陆舟听玩家把话递给程雨，没插嘴，只把插在兜里的手抽出来一只，朝台面上那本日记的方向抬了抬下巴，示意东西还在原处。", "speech": "听见了。日记还在桌上，你俩交接。", "addresseeIds": ["character:player", "character:friend"]}

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Items already in the player's custody: []. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Items already in the player's custody: []. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Imperatives, permission, delegation and asking someone to keep an item are communication. They do not mean the player has already handed it over. Preserve the speaker, addressee and requested actor in the speech quote. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Only an explicit intended continuing custody change by the player warrants a custody interaction. Bare lifting, lifting to look, and setting down state physical handling; use narrate without inferring custody. Intending to carry an unassigned item away is take; handling or packing an already custodial item is not another take. If the exact intended item is unavailable, clarify; never choose a different item merely because its action is offered. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。观察中的 playerInput 是完整原始玩家输入，用来核对谁在说话、邀请谁做什么；抽取片段可能不完整。原文和邀请不证明行动成功，实际状态仍以裁定结果及可见物品为准。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。
